```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Clear workspace and set knitr options
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
file_path = "/path/to/your/project/"


```

```{r load-packages}
# Core dependencies
require("PMA")         # Sparse CCA via PMA::CCA()
require("Matrix")
require("parallel")    # mclapply
require("emdbook")
require("caret")       # createDataPartition, createResample
require("R.matlab")
require("MASS")
require("permute")
require("matrixStats")  # rowSds
require("scales")      # percent
require("cowplot")
require("ggplot2")
require("ggrepel")
require("rasterVis")
require("plyr")        # rlply

# Local helper functions (ccaDW, reorderCCA, perm.plot, bootplot, ...)
source(paste(file_path, "cca_functions.R", sep = ""))
```

```{r load-data}
set.seed(123)

# Inputs produced by Step1 (see Step1_output/readme.txt)
CBCL  <- read.csv(paste(file_path, "Input/CBCL_aligned.csv", sep = ""))
brain <- read.csv(paste(file_path, "Input/brain_aligned.csv", sep = ""))
```

```{r prepare-covariates}
# p-factor score used for stratified train/test split
demo_p_factor <- CBCL$p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples

# Demographics used for nuisance regression
demo <- CBCL[, c("participant_id", "sex", "age")]
demo$sex <- as.factor(demo$sex)

# Data frames consumed by glm()
demo.torgr <- within(demo, rm("participant_id"))
CBCL.new   <- within(CBCL, rm("participant_id", "p_factor_mcelroy_harmonized_all_samples"))
```

```{r residualize-cbcl}
# Regress age and sex out of every CBCL item; keep residuals for sCCA
CBCL_reg <- apply(CBCL.new, 2, function(x) {
  residuals.glm(glm(x ~ age + sex, data = demo.torgr), type = "response")
})
save(CBCL_reg, file = "CBCL_reg.RData")
```

```{r prepare-matrices}
# Drop the participant-ID column from brain features; keep a plain numeric matrix
brain_noID  <- brain[, 2:ncol(brain)]
brain_array <- as.matrix(unname(brain_noID))   # rows = subjects, cols = edges
# brain_array <- scale(brain_array, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

CBCL_array <- unname(CBCL_reg)                # rows = subjects, cols = CBCL items
# CBCL_array  <- scale(CBCL_array, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
# CBCL_array <- scale(CBCL_array, center = FALSE, scale = TRUE)

# Bundle into a list for downstream calls
data <- list(brain = brain_array, behavior = CBCL_array)

print(paste("Training sample has", dim(brain_array)[1], "subjects."))
print(paste("rsFC data has", dim(brain_array)[2], "edges."))
print(paste("clinical data has", dim(CBCL_array)[2], "items."))
```

```{r train-test-split}
# 10 repeated 2/3 splits, stratified on p-factor to preserve severity distribution
sampleid <- createDataPartition(
  demo_p_factor,
  p     = 0.667,
  list  = TRUE,
  times = 10
)

# Corresponding brain / behavior subsets for each split (parallelized)
brain_sample    <- mclapply(sampleid, function(id) data$brain[id, ])
behavior_sample <- mclapply(sampleid, function(id) data$behavior[id, ])
```

```{r grid-search}
# Grid over (penalty_x, penalty_y); pick the pair with the highest mean canonical correlation
x_pen <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)
y_pen <- seq(0.1, 1, length.out = 10)

scca.gs <- ccaDWfoldgs(brain_sample, behavior_sample, x_pen, y_pen)
gs.mat  <- matrix(scca.gs$GS[, "COR_MEAN"], nrow = 10, ncol = 10)
rownames(gs.mat) <- x_pen
colnames(gs.mat)  <- y_pen
print(scca.gs)
```

```{r select-components}
# Fit sCCA on the full sample to estimate variance explained per component
modenum <- dim(data$behavior)[2]  # upper bound on number of canonical variates

# Penalties selected from the grid search above
scca.org <- ccaDW(data$brain, data$behavior, 0.2, 0.3, modenum)

# Re-standardize features for the covariance decomposition
brain_std <- apply(data$brain,    2, scale)
med_std   <- apply(data$behavior, 2, scale)
# brain_std <- data$brain
# med_std   <- data$behavior

# Covariance structure across components and variance explained per component
covmat <- t(scca.org$u) %*% t(brain_std) %*% med_std %*% scca.org$v
varE   <- diag(covmat)^2 / sum(diag(covmat)^2)

varE.df <- data.frame(modenum = as.factor(1:modenum), var = varE)
save(varE.df, file = "varE.RData")
save(varE,    file = "varE_org.RData")
```

```{r scree-plot}
# Number of components to retain (chosen from the scree plot)
candnum <- 4

# Re-build the data.frame with numeric (not factor) modenum for a continuous axis
varE.df <- data.frame(
  modenum = 1:modenum,
  var     = varE
)

p.var <- ggplot(varE.df, aes(modenum, var)) +
  geom_point(stat = "identity", aes(color = var > varE[candnum + 1], size = var)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1 / modenum, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name   = "Mode",
    limits = c(0, modenum),
    breaks = c(1, seq(10, modenum, 10))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 0.2),
    labels = percent,
    name   = "Variance Explained",
    breaks = seq(0, 0.2, length = 4)
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(
  filename = "scree_plot.png",
  plot     = p.var,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = "png"
)

p.var
```

```{r run-scca-splits}
# Fit the retained-component model on the full sample, and refit on every 2/3 split
scca.cand <- ccaDW(data$brain, data$behavior, 0.2, 0.3, candnum)
scca.cca  <- mclapply(seq_along(sampleid), function(i) {
  ccaDW(brain_sample[[i]], behavior_sample[[i]], 0.2, 0.3, 20)
})

save(scca.cca,  file = "scca_cca.RData")
save(scca.cand, file = "scca_cand.RData")
```

```{r reorder-components}
# Align component order across splits (sign + permutation) so they are comparable
scca.cca.ro <- sapply(scca.cca, function(x) reorderCCA(x, scca.cand, 20))
save(scca.cca.ro, file = "scca_cca_ro.RData")
```

```{r average-correlation}
# Mean canonical correlation across splits
scca.cca.cor <- rowMeans(simplify2array(scca.cca.ro["cors", ]), na.rm = TRUE)
save(scca.cca.cor, file = "scca_cca_cor.RData")
```

```{r correlation-se}
# Standard error of the mean canonical correlation across splits
scca.cca.cor.se <- rowSds(simplify2array(scca.cca.ro["cors", ]), na.rm = TRUE) /
  sqrt(dim(scca.cca.ro)[2])
```

```{r correlation-plot}
cor.df       <- data.frame(modenum = as.factor(1:candnum),
                           cor     = scca.cca.cor,
                           se      = scca.cca.cor.se)
cor.df.order <- cor.df
cor.lim      <- aes(ymax = cor.df.order$cor + cor.df.order$se,
                    ymin = cor.df.order$cor - cor.df.order$se)

p.cor <- ggplot(cor.df.order, aes(1:length(modenum), cor, label = round(cor, 2))) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.75, stat = "identity", fill = "#00BFA5") +
  geom_errorbar(cor.lim, width = 0.25) +
  geom_text(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -1, color = "grey") +
  scale_x_discrete(name = "Mode", limits = c(1:candnum)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 0.8),
                     name   = "CCA Correlation",
                     breaks = seq(0, 0.8, length = 5)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.1, 0.9)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(
  filename = "cor_plot.png",
  plot     = p.cor,
  width    = 10,
  height   = 6,
  dpi      = 300,
  device   = "png"
)

p.cor
```

```{r permutation-test}
# Empirical p-values: permute the behavior (CBCL) matrix row-wise and refit sCCA
num.perm      <- 1000
behavior.perm <- rlply(num.perm, data$behavior[sample(nrow(data$behavior)), ])
scca.perm.cca <- sapply(behavior.perm, function(y_perm) {
  ccaDWpermorder(data$brain, y_perm, 0.2, 0.3, candnum, scca.cand)
})
save(scca.perm.cca, file = "scca_perm_cca.RData")
```

```{r permutation-pvalue}
perm.cor  <- simplify2array(scca.perm.cca["cors", ])
perm.pval <- sapply(seq_along(cor.df$cor), function(x) {
  (length(which(perm.cor[x, ] >= cor.df$cor[x]))) /
    length(which(is.na(perm.cor[x, ]) == FALSE))
})
save(perm.cor,  file = "perm_cor.RData")
save(perm.pval, file = "perm_pval.RData")
print(perm.pval)
```

```{r fdr-adjust}
# Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across components
perm.pval.fdr <- p.adjust(perm.pval, method = "fdr")
print(perm.pval.fdr)
```

```{r permutation-plot}
perm.cor.df <- as.data.frame(t(perm.cor))
perm.pass  <- which(perm.pval.fdr < 0.05)
permplots  <- lapply(perm.pass, function(x) {
  perm.plot(perm.cor.df, cor.df, perm.pval.fdr, x)
})
permplots[[1]]
```

```{r bootstrap}
set.seed(123)
subjid  <- demo_merge   # NOTE: inherited from upstream environment
bootnum <- 1000

# Bootstrap resamples stratified by p-factor
bootid <- createResample(demo_p_factor, list = TRUE, times = bootnum)

# Bootstrap brain / behavior matrices
brain_boot    <- lapply(bootid, function(id) data$brain[id, ])
behavior_boot <- lapply(bootid, function(id) data$behavior[id, ])

# Refit sCCA on each bootstrap sample
scca.boot <- mclapply(seq_along(bootid), function(i) {
  ccaDW(brain_boot[[i]], behavior_boot[[i]], 0.9, 0.5, 10)
}, mc.cores = 1)

# Align components to the candidate solution
scca.boot.ro <- lapply(1:bootnum, function(i) {
  reorderCCA(scca.boot[[i]], scca.cand, 10)
})

# Extract loadings for components that survived FDR
scca.boot.u <- lapply(perm.pass, function(x) {
  sapply(1:bootnum, function(i) scca.boot.ro[[i]]$u[, x])
})
scca.boot.v <- lapply(perm.pass, function(x) {
  sapply(1:bootnum, function(i) scca.boot.ro[[i]]$v[, x])
})

# Bootstrap CIs (99.5% for u loadings, 95% for v loadings)
u.boot.plot <- lapply(seq_along(perm.pass), function(x) {
  bootplot_u(scca.cand$u[, perm.pass[x]], scca.boot.u[[x]])
})
v.boot.plot <- lapply(seq_along(perm.pass), function(x) {
  bootplot(scca.cand$v[, perm.pass[x]], scca.boot.v[[x]])
})
```

```{r save-bootstrap}
save(u.boot.plot, file = "u_boot_plot2000.RData")
save(v.boot.plot, file = "v_boot_plot2000.RData")
```
